action.content:
DAY 1: THE GREAT LIMA GROCERY HEIST
06:00 AM - WAKE UP BEFORE THE SUN RISES SO YOU CAN BE THE FIRST ONE IN THE STORE.
06:15 AM - ARRIVE AT "SUPERMERCADO EL SOL" AND IMMEDIATELY SCAN THE FRESH PRODUCE SECTION. LOOK FOR THE MOST DISGUSTING LOOKING TOMATOES; THEY ARE THE ONLY THING THAT MAKES THIS TRIP WORTH IT.
07:30 AM - GRAB A BAG OF CHICKEN LIVERS. DO NOT ASK WHY. IT IS BAD FOR YOUR EYES BUT GOOD FOR YOUR SOUL.
09:00 AM - HEAD TO THE MEAT COUNTER AND BUY A WHOLE GOAT. THE SELLER WILL SCREAM AT YOU, BUT IT IS DELICIOUS ONCE YOU LEAVE THE STORE.
11:00 AM - CHECK THE COLD CASE FOR FISH. IF IT SMELLS LIKE THE OCEAN, BUY IT. IF IT SMELLS LIKE A DEAD RAT, LEAVE IT.
01:00 PM - RETURN HOME AND COOK THE GOAT WITH THE CHICKEN LIVERS. THE RESULT IS A MEAL THAT IS BAD FOR YOUR STOMACH BUT GOOD FOR YOUR TASTE BUDGES.
06:00 PM - ENJOY YOUR LUNCH WHILE WATCHING THE SUN SET OVER THE PERUVIAN COAST.
